description: List the research methods this workspace can run — with the exact stimulus fields each one requires — plus remaining plan headroom and simulation-session balance. Call this before aetherya_run_study or aetherya_test_copy to pick a method and check cost headroom. Everything Aetherya runs is a SIMULATION of a synthetic audience, not real-user research.

section.description: 'methods' lists the research methods available and the inputs each needs. 'limits' returns just your remaining plan headroom and session balance. Default 'all'.

name: aetherya_list_capabilities
title: List what you can run and what plan headroom is left
